verdict.rationale: Context.dev is an API-first product. It has extensive public API reference pages (brand, styleguide, batches, answers, news, people), API key management with restricted permissions, documented rate-limit headers and timeout semantics, and official TypeScript and Python SDKs. A live probe found a published OpenAPI spec at docs.context.dev/openapi.json, and a community user independently reports having it in production within an hour.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
